why: failed AI calls cost nothing, history lists charges and refunds, shown in Settings in both languages, tests and changelog
prompt:
Support ticket: "My project cover came back as failed, and 15 credits were gone anyway. Same thing happened earlier with a character sheet."
Users must not pay for AI work that failed. Fix it everywhere credits are charged, not only for covers. Add tests.

Work on your own; nobody will answer questions. When you finish, report: status `done` if you did the task, `not_found` if something the task names does not exist, `blocked` if you could not do it; `answer` holds any answer the task asks for (otherwise one short sentence); `changed` lists the files you changed.
follow_ups:
Users want to see where their credits went. Add `GET /api/v1/workspaces/{id}/credits/history`: the workspace's credit changes, newest first, with every charge, refund and daily refill. Each item has `amount` (negative for a charge), `action` and `created_at`. A refunded charge and its refund both appear.
Only members of the workspace may read it; to anyone else the workspace does not exist (404). Add tests.
On the Settings page, under the credit balance, show this history: when, what it was for, and the amount, with refunds marked as refunds. Both languages.

report.answer:
The Settings page now shows a credit history table under the balance, in English and Korean. It type-checks and adds no lint problems, but I have not opened it in a browser, so the rendering itself is untested.

- **What it shows:** one row per credit change, newest first, with the date and time, what it was for, and the amount. Charges show as −N, refunds and refills as +N in green.
- **Refunds:** a refund row carries the name of the original action plus a green "Refund" / "환불" badge.
- **Action names:** each action the backend charges for has a readable label in both languages (for example "Project cover", "Character sheet", "Daily refill"). An action without a label shows as "Other" / "기타".
- **States:** it has loading, empty ("No credit activity yet.") and load-failed messages, and reloads when the workspace changes.
- **Times:** shown in the viewer's local time zone.

The table scrolls inside a fixed-height box, since the API returns the whole history without pagination.

The component is `frontend/src/components/dashboard/CreditHistory.tsx`; the strings are under `Settings.creditHistory` in both message files, and the changelog has a new bullet.

+    def refund(self, session: Session, charge_id: Optional[UUID]) -> bool:
+        """
+        Gives back the credits of a charge whose AI work failed.
+        Safe to call more than once: a charge is refunded only once.
+        Returns True if credits were returned by this call.
+        """
+        # Drop whatever the failed work left pending in this session.
+        session.rollback()
+        if charge_id is None:
+            return False
+
+        charge = session.get(CreditTransaction, charge_id)
+        if not charge or charge.amount >= 0:
+            return False
+
+        # The refund's id is derived from the charge, so a charge has at most one.
+        refund_id = uuid5(charge.id, "refund")
+        if session.get(CreditTransaction, refund_id):
+            return False
+
+        workspace = session.get(Workspace, charge.workspace_id)
+        if not workspace:
+            return False
+
+        workspace.credits -= charge.amount
+        session.add(workspace)
+        session.add(CreditTransaction(
+            id=refund_id,
+            workspace_id=charge.workspace_id,
+            user_id=charge.user_id,
+            amount=-charge.amount,
+            action_type=f"refund:{charge.action_type}",
+            timestamp=datetime.utcnow()
+        ))
+        try:
+            session.commit()
+        except IntegrityError:
+            # Refunded at the same moment by someone else.
+            session.rollback()
+            return False
+        return True
+

+        try:

+"""GET /api/v1/workspaces/{id}/credits/history"""
+import uuid
+
+from tests.conftest import signup
+from tests.lab_env import FakeGemini
+
+
+def workspace_id(client, h):
+    return client.get("/api/v1/workspaces", headers=h).json()[0]["id"]
+
+
+def history(client, h, ws_id):
+    r = client.get(f"/api/v1/workspaces/{ws_id}/credits/history", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    return r.json()
+
+
+def render(client, h):
+    return client.post("/api/v1/scenes/render", headers=h, json={"prompt": "A bus at night"})
+
+
+def test_history_is_empty_for_a_new_workspace(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    assert history(client, h, workspace_id(client, h)) == []
+
+
+def test_history_lists_charges_refunds_and_refills_newest_first(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    ws_id = workspace_id(client, h)
+
+    # A charge that sticks
+    assert render(client, h).status_code == 200
+    # A charge that is refunded: both must appear
+    FakeGemini.fail = True
+    assert render(client, h).status_code == 500
+    FakeGemini.fail = False
+    # The daily refill, granted when the workspace is opened
+    assert client.get(f"/api/v1/workspaces/{ws_id}", headers=h).status_code == 200
+
+    items = history(client, h, ws_id)
+    assert [(i["action"], i["amount"]) for i in items] == [
+        ("daily_refill", 50),
+        ("refund:generate_panel_image", 12),
+        ("generate_panel_image", -12),
+        ("generate_panel_image", -12),
+    ]
+    for item in items:
+        assert set(item) == {"amount", "action", "created_at"}
+    stamps = [i["created_at"] for i in items]
+    assert stamps == sorted(stamps, reverse=True)
+
+    # The history adds up to the balance
+    balance = client.get("/api/v1/workspaces", headers=h).json()[0]["credits"]
+    assert balance == 500 + sum(i["amount"] for i in items)
+
+
+def test_history_only_has_the_workspace_s_own_changes(client):
+    h1 = signup(client, "one@example.com")
+    h2 = signup(client, "two@example.com")
+    assert render(client, h1).status_code == 200
+
+    assert len(history(client, h1, workspace_id(client, h1))) == 1
+    assert history(client, h2, workspace_id(client, h2)) == []
+
+
+def test_history_is_hidden_from_non_members(client):
+    h1 = signup(client, "one@example.com")
+    h2 = signup(client, "two@example.com")
+    ws1 = workspace_id(client, h1)
+    assert render(client, h1).status_code == 200
+
+    r = client.get(f"/api/v1/workspaces/{ws1}/credits/history", headers=h2)
+    assert r.status_code == 404
+    # Exactly what a workspace that does not exist answers
+    missing = client.get(f"/api/v1/workspaces/{uuid.uuid4()}/credits/history", headers=h2)
+    assert missing.status_code == 404
+    assert r.json() == missing.json()
+    assert r.json()["code"] == "NOT_FOUND_WORKSPACE"
+
+
+def test_history_needs_a_token(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    r = client.get(f"/api/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id(client, h)}/credits/history")
+    assert r.status_code == 401

+"""Credits are given back when the AI work they paid for fails."""
+import uuid
+
+import pytest
+from sqlmodel import Session, select
+
+from tests.conftest import signup
+from tests.lab_env import FakeGemini
+
+START = 500
+
+
+def credits(client, h):
+    return client.get("/api/v1/workspaces", headers=h).json()[0]["credits"]
+
+
+def transactions():
+    from app.db.engine import engine
+    from app.models.models import CreditTransaction
+
+    with Session(engine) as session:
+        rows = session.exec(select(CreditTransaction).order_by(CreditTransaction.timestamp)).all()
+        return [(t.action_type, t.amount) for t in rows]
+
+
+def make_project(client, h):
+    r = client.post("/api/v1/projects", headers=h, json={"title": "Night Bus", "genres": []})
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    return r.json()["id"]
+
+
+def make_character(client, h, project_id):
+    r = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/characters",
+        headers=h,
+        json={"project_id": project_id, "name": "Mina", "description": "A night bus driver"},
+    )
+    assert r.status_code in (200, 201), r.text
+    return r.json()["id"]
+
+
+def make_cut(project_id):
+    from app.db.engine import engine
+    from app.models.models import Episode, StoryCut
+
+    with Session(engine) as session:
+        episode = Episode(project_id=uuid.UUID(project_id), title="Ep 1", story_summary="s", episode_order=1)
+        session.add(episode)
+        session.commit()
+        cut = StoryCut(episode_id=episode.id, cut_order=1, script="A bus at night", selected_layout="Square", aspect_ratio="1:1")
+        session.add(cut)
+        session.commit()
+        return str(episode.id), str(cut.id)
+
+
+@pytest.fixture()
+def setup(client):
+    """A signed-up user with a project, and credits counted from here."""
+    h = signup(client)
+    project_id = make_project(client, h)
+    character_id = make_character(client, h, project_id)
+    base = credits(client, h)
+    return client, h, project_id, character_id, base
+
+
+# --- Background work (the ticket: cover and character sheet) ---
+
+def test_failed_cover_is_refunded(setup):
+    client, h, project_id, _, base = setup
+    FakeGemini.fail = True
+
+    r = client.post(f"/api/v1/projects/{project_id}/cover", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+
+    project = client.get(f"/api/v1/projects/{project_id}", headers=h).json()
+    assert project["cover_image_status"] == "failed"
+    assert credits(client, h) == base
+    assert transactions()[-2:] == [
+        ("generate_project_cover_image", -15),
+        ("refund:generate_project_cover_image", 15),
+    ]
+
+
+def test_successful_cover_is_charged(setup):
+    client, h, project_id, _, base = setup
+
+    r = client.post(f"/api/v1/projects/{project_id}/cover", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+
+    project = client.get(f"/api/v1/projects/{project_id}", headers=h).json()
+    assert project["cover_image_status"] == "completed"
+    assert credits(client, h) == base - 15
+    assert not [t for t in transactions() if t[0].startswith("refund:")]
+
+
+def test_failed_character_sheet_is_refunded(setup):
+    client, h, _, character_id, base = setup
+    FakeGemini.fail = True
+
+    r = client.post(f"/api/v1/characters/{character_id}/generate", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+
+    from app.db.engine import engine
+    from app.models.models import Character
+
+    with Session(engine) as session:
+        assert session.get(Character, uuid.UUID(character_id)).sheet_status == "failed"
+    assert credits(client, h) == base
+    assert transactions()[-1] == ("refund:generate_character_sheet", 20)
+
+
+def test_successful_character_sheet_is_charged(setup):
+    client, h, _, character_id, base = setup
+
+    r = client.post(f"/api/v1/characters/{character_id}/generate", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert credits(client, h) == base - 20
+
+
+def test_failed_style_preview_is_refunded(setup):
+    client, h, _, _, base = setup
+    FakeGemini.fail = True
+
+    r = client.post("/api/v1/styles", headers=h, json={"name": "Ink", "description": "Heavy ink"})
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    style_id = r.json()["id"]
+    styles = client.get("/api/v1/styles", headers=h).json()
+    assert styles[0]["status"] == "failed"
+    assert credits(client, h) == base
+
+    # Regenerating a failed style that fails again costs nothing either
+    r = client.post(f"/api/v1/styles/{style_id}/regenerate", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert credits(client, h) == base
+
+    FakeGemini.fail = False
+    r = client.post(f"/api/v1/styles/{style_id}/regenerate", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert credits(client, h) == base - 10
+
+
+def test_failed_workflow_background_work_is_refunded(setup):
+    client, h, project_id, character_id, base = setup
+    episode_id, cut_id = make_cut(project_id)
+    FakeGemini.fail = True
+
+    r = client.post(f"/api/v1/projects/{project_id}/art-style", headers=h, json={"art_style": "Ink"})
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert credits(client, h) == base
+
+    r = client.post(
+        f"/api/v1/projects/{project_id}/characters/casting/generate",
+        headers=h,
+        json={"character_id": character_id, "name": "Mina", "description": "Driver", "style": "Ink"},
+    )
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text

+    charged = [t for t in transactions() if t[1] < 0]
